verification.method: unittest offline in CI on every PR and before every update; real gh run by hand

test.title: FreshBlock
test.checks: whole-file equality: two rows with different dates (18 ноября 2026, 1 марта 2026) in REPOS order; a second run with a newer humanizer-ru release changes only its row

test.title: SafeBlock
test.checks: either repo failing; each of the three fields alone missing/null/blank/multiline, a foreign or non-release URL, a non-date; markers missing, doubled, nested start, extra end, reversed, START not ending its line: exit 1, README bytes unchanged

test.title: GhBoundary
test.checks: real latest() with subprocess.run faked: JSON answers land in the block and the calls are gh api repos/Vladimir-Human/<repo>/releases/latest; every call has timeout=60 and TimeoutExpired fails safely; gh exit 1 or non-JSON from either repo fails safely

test.title: live GitHub
test.checks: printed [M-RELEASES][BLOCK_WRITE] updated with v2.11.1 and v4.3.0, both 18 ноября 2026, matching gh release view; latest('no-such-repo-zz9') raised LookupError with HTTP 404

gaps.gap: Proven only by a run against live GitHub; the log line of each scheduled run is in the Actions log of the workflow.
Proven by the Actions history after merge (one scheduled run per day); not checkable before the change is on main.
The look on a phone is decided by the owner's screen; the agent checks the rendered page in a browser at phone width.
